evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 300-Ki Namekian Awoken Skill. The transformation replaces the normal moveset, grants a form of hyper armor, and continuously drains Stamina; movement and melee attacks can consume additional Stamina. Current documentation reports +15% Basic Attack, +10% Basic Ki Blast, +10% Ki Skill, +15% Strike Skill, +40% Ki auto-recovery, -50% Stamina recovery, and a -40% Stamina auto-drain modifier, while also documenting that the form has no Ultimate/Evasive skills, no normal guard, and no Z-Vanish. Exact balance values are retained as source-reported current-scope data rather than timeless patch-independent claims.
unresolved: Exact frame data is not asserted unless directly documented.
